REVIEW: define allowed amounts, whether lethal payment is allowed, and whether healing uses the chosen amount or damage actually dealt after prevention/modifiers.

Effect: Hoď kostkou a vyleč libovolné své jednotce a svému hrdinovi tolik životů.
EffectVirtual: On play: choose a friendly minion, generate one uniformly random integer from 1 through 6, then heal that minion and your hero by the same result, capped at maximum health. REVIEW: confirm the random range and define playability if there is no friendly minion.
Flavor: Nejsem si jist čerstvostí této bagety.

Effect: Tvé karty a schopnosti které léčí teď místo toho dávají poškození.
EffectVirtual: While on the board, replace healing from your cards and abilities with damage to the same recipients for the corresponding amounts. This is an effect replacement, not a reaction after healing. REVIEW: define damage modifiers, heal-to-full effects, Lifesteal recursion and interaction with doubled healing/damage.
Flavor: Proč jste mu na kašel dal projímadlo? Vždyť koukejte, tamhle stojí a bojí se zakašlat!

Effect: Obránce, Lifesteal, Při smrti: Znič náhodnou protivníkovu jednotku.
EffectVirtual: Taunt and Lifesteal. On death: destroy one uniformly random enemy minion, if any, using the shared random/choice service. Lifesteal heals your hero by the full damage this minion deals, including overkill, capped at maximum health. Shield or other full damage prevention produces no Lifesteal healing.

Effect: Znič VŠECHNY jednotky, za každou zničenou si lízni kartu.
EffectVirtual: On play: destroy all minions on both sides, then draw one card for each minion destroyed by this effect. Snapshot targets and count actual destructions. REVIEW: whether indirectly destroyed minions from death-effect chains also count.

Effect: Dej náhodně 2-4 poškození postavě a vyvolej tolik zmutovaných krys.
EffectVirtual: On play: choose any character, select a uniformly random integer from 2 through 4, deal that amount of base spell damage, and summon that many Zmutovaná krysa tokens for yourself. REVIEW: whether the number summoned follows the random roll, modified damage or actual damage dealt; the proposed reading uses the roll.

Effect: None
EffectVirtual: No additional effect. Use the token's normal stats and rules.
Flavor: “Crazy? I was crazy once… they put me in a room - rubber room - rubber room with rats, the rats made me crazy.”

Effect: Pokaždé, když tato jednotka ztratí životy, vyvolej zmutovanou krysu.
EffectVirtual: Whenever this minion actually loses health to damage, summon one Zmutovaná krysa for yourself, once per damage event rather than per health point, subject to board space. Apply the shared damage-received ordering: lethal damage triggers the summon before this minion dies; prevented damage does not trigger it.

Effect: Dej +4/+4 své jednotce, na konci tvého kola tato jednotka zemře. Smutné.
EffectVirtual: On play: choose a friendly minion and permanently give it +4 attack and +4 current and maximum health. Schedule destruction of that instance at the end of your current turn. REVIEW: define what happens if it changes control, transforms or leaves and re-enters before the delayed destruction.

Effect: Při zahrání: Tvá následující karta toto kolo stojí životy místo many.
EffectVirtual: On play: your next card played this turn costs hero health instead of mana. Consume on that play and expire unused at turn end. REVIEW: define the amount after cost modifiers, whether payment is damage, whether immunity can prevent it, and whether lethal payment is allowed.

Effect: Tvé následující kouzlo toto kolo stojí životy místo many.
EffectVirtual: On play: your next spell played this turn costs hero health instead of mana. Consume only on a spell play and expire unused at turn end. REVIEW: define the amount after cost modifiers, whether payment is damage, immunity and lethal-payment rules.
Flavor: Modrá skalice se používá jako herbicid, tahle jako HPcid.

Effect: Spal si ruku a znič všechny jednotky na stole.
EffectVirtual: On play: snapshot every card remaining in your hand and all minions on both sides before resolution. Discard the snapshotted hand cards, then destroy the snapshotted minions with normal death effects. Do not include cards or minions generated during resolution. Keep discard and minion-death events distinct and apply the shared deterministic effect queue.
Flavor: AU! TO PÁLÍ!! Nemůžeš místo ohně použít UV záření?!!!

Effect: Má vždy právě tolik útoku jako života.
EffectVirtual: Continuous attack setter: this minion's attack always equals its current health. Recompute after every health change, including damage, healing and stat changes; do not accumulate buffs. REVIEW: define precedence over other attack buffs/setters and silence behavior.
Flavor: Taky máte v Minecraftu toho kamaráda?

Effect: Zdvojnásob jednotce životy.
EffectVirtual: On play: choose any minion and double its health. REVIEW: specify whether to double current health only, maximum health only, or both, and whether this is a stat change rather than healing.

Effect: Nastav jednotce útok roven jejím životům.
EffectVirtual: On play: choose any minion and set its attack to its current health at resolution. This is a one-time assignment, unlike Kilotuna TNT's continuous rule. REVIEW: define interaction with existing attack auras.
Flavor: Teoretické vysvětlování, co to je stechiometrizace přehlušuje pochrupování studentů, aspoň dokud obtížnost testu není rovná nevrlosti učitele.

Effect: Při zahrání: Ovládni protivníkovu jednotku s méně než 2 útoky.
EffectVirtual: On play: choose an enemy minion with current attack strictly less than 2 and take control of it. Validate attack and enemy ownership. Move it to your rightmost empty minion slot, preserving stats/statuses and disabling attacks by default; if there is no space, destroy it without death effects for either player. Use GameManager.TakeControl(minion, newController, allowImmediateAttack: false); transfer the existing minion and attached card without replaying or summoning them.

Effect: Poškození i léčení tvých kouzel a schopností je dvojnásobné.
EffectVirtual: While on the board, double damage and healing from your spells and abilities. Do not automatically double minion combat or minion-triggered damage. REVIEW: define ordering with additive spell damage and healing-to-damage conversion, stacking with multiple copies, and whether resource payments are excluded.

Effect: Při zahrání: Vyměň si životy s jinou jednotkou.
EffectVirtual: On play: choose another minion on either side and swap its current health with this minion's current health. Snapshot both values before assignment. REVIEW: define maximum-health changes and interaction with health-dependent auras.

Effect: Při zahrání: Následující dvě kola hraje protivník, pak dvě ty.
EffectVirtual: Deferred: do not implement this card yet. Intended effect: after the current turn, the opponent takes two turns, then you take two turns. Turn-queue composition and resumption rules remain future design work. When resumed, use actual turn identities for start/end events, mana, draws and effect durations.
Flavor: Že pracuieš už 16 hodin? Lháři. Za trest dalších osm! TBS chyby nedělá!

Effect: Každá jednotka přijde při vyvolání o 1 útok.
EffectVirtual: While this field is active, whenever any minion is summoned on either side, reduce its attack by 1. This applies to each new summon rather than continuously to existing minions. REVIEW: define minimum attack (proposed: 0) and whether the reduction persists after the field leaves.
Flavor: Zelenou enerigii? My jsme progresivní, používáme černou!

Effect: Po vyvolání dostane +1/+1 za každý bug, co už jsi tuto hru vyvolal.
EffectVirtual: On summon: permanently gain +1 attack and +1 current and maximum health for each Bug previously summoned by this token's controller during this game. The current Bug is not included in the count because the printed text says already summoned.
